title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Exactly WWW LLC…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the EWWW Image Optimizer plugin by Exactly WWW LLC, affecting versions up to 8.9.1. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.1.
